propositions: reconcile bridge runs on github actions are not publishing failure signals to cloudwatch, leaving bridge auth failures and other run-time outages entirely invisible to monitoring
github actions workflows can authenticate to aws via oidc and publish cloudwatch metrics, but the current rebar codebase does not implement this for bridge run health

publishing a metric value of 0 on success and 1 on failure, rather than only publishing on failure, makes the publisher itself observable and prevents the alarm from sitting in INSUFFICIENT_DATA during healthy periods

a cloudwatch alarm on bridge_run_failures with period 3600 and threshold 1 will page after a second failure within the hour, distinguishing sustained outages from transient blips in the ~20-minute bridge run cadence
the iam role granting cloudwatch:PutMetricData must be narrowly scoped by namespace condition to rebar/host and must not widen existing roles like rebar-terraform-plan or the bedrock ci role
